programme.title: Crazy Westerners
programme.desc: Geïnspireerd door het leven van Hank Garland, is CRAZY het verhaal van een legendarische gitarist die in de jaren vijftig uit Nashville kwam.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: Een bende wapensmokkelaars wordt gezocht door zowel de Mexicaanse Rurales als de Yaqui-indianen. De Rurales willen voorkomen dat de indianen onschuldige boeren aanvallen, terwijl de indianen wraak willen nemen voor de valse medicijnen die hun kinderen blind maakten. De bende wordt gevangen, maar beiden worden omsingeld door de woedende indianen in een verlaten missie. Kunnen politie en criminelen samenwerken om te overleven?

programme.title: Shoot the Living and Pray for the Dead
programme.desc: Nadat Dan Hogan en zijn bende een bank hebben overvallen, huren ze een mysterieuze man in om hen over de Mexicaanse grens te leiden in ruil voor de helft van de buit.

programme.title: Day of the Outlaw
programme.desc: Blaise Starrett is een rancher die in conflict komt met boeren wanneer outlaws het stadje overvallen.

programme.title: Anda muchacho, spara! (Dead Men Ride)
programme.desc: Roy ontsnapt uit een werkkamp en vindt onderdak bij mijnwerkers die onderdrukt worden door de wrede Redfield. Terwijl hij hen helpt in hun strijd, grijpt hij ook de kans om oude rekeningen te vereffenen voor een gevallen vriend. Maar vrijheid heeft zijn prijs.

programme.title: Guns Of The Revolution
programme.desc: In Mexico leidt een krankzinnige generaal zijn eigen oorlog tegen de kerk.

programme.title: Day of Anger
programme.desc: Bankoverval uitgevoerd door de bank ambtenaren, niet de gebruikelijke James bende.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: Een eenzame schutter spoort de leden van een vogelvrije bende op die zijn vrienden hebben vermoord.

programme.title: Kill Johnny Ringo!
programme.desc: Texas Ranger Johnny Ringo probeert een bende valsemunters op te rollen, maar raakt verstrikt in een web van passie en verraad. Terwijl hij de driehoeksverhouding tussen de saloonzangeres Annie, haar minnaar Jackson en rancher Ray onderzoekt, ontdekt hij dat de ware dader dichterbij is dan gedacht — zijn eigen partner, de sheriff.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Een inhalige Poolse huurling helpt een mijnwerker en een boerenmeisje bij het leiden van een revolutie tegen de onderdrukkende Mexicaanse regering, en wordt achtervolgd door een Amerikaanse rivaal.

programme.title: Killer Caliber 32
programme.desc: Huurmoordenaar Silver doodt de zeven leden van een gemaskerde bende één voor één met behulp van zilveren kogels en zijn eigen code van gerechtigheid. Tussen pokerspelletjes en saloonmeisjes door leidt zijn missie tot de dramatische ontmaskering van de meedogenloze leider van de bende. Silver's stijl en eer maken hem tot een dodelijke kracht in dit verhaal vol actie.

programme.title: Dynamite Jim
programme.desc: Spion Dynamite Jim smokkelt Mexicaans goud door gevaarlijk rebellengebied naar een fort in Iowa. Onderweg wordt hij verraden door een hebzuchtige partner, belaagd door een corrupte bankier en bedreigd door een meedogenloze bandiet, maar krijgt steun van een charmante danseres.

programme.title: Fistful of Lead
programme.desc: Sartana krijgt te maken met verschillende partijen - waaronder een dappere rivaliserende revolverheld, een verleidelijke salooneigenaar en een Mexicaanse bandiet - die het goud van een mijndirecteur willen bemachtigen.

programme.title: Pancho Villa
programme.desc: Een verraad in een wapendeal zet de Mexicaanse revolutionair Pancho Villa ertoe aan een wapenopslagplaats van het Amerikaanse leger in Columbus, New Mexico, te overvallen.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: Kapitein Tom Harvey, een undercover legeragent, onderzoekt de diefstal van goudzendingen en neemt een baan als adjunct-sheriff in een stad die geteisterd wordt door een spook. Het spook zou een verkeerd veroordeelde gokker zijn, die voor de diefstallen werd opgehangen. Harvey ontdekt het mysterie achter het spook.

programme.title: Showdown At Williams Creek
programme.desc: Een Britse soldaat besluit naar de Amerikaanse grens te verhuizen en een nieuw leven te beginnen. Hij vindt de grens zwaar en worstelt met het klimaat, dieven en oplichters. Hij wordt beschuldigd van moord en berecht.

programme.title: Gunfight at Red Sands
programme.desc: Een eenzame buitenstaander keert terug om de dood van zijn familie te wreken. Gewapend met vastberadenheid en gedreven door woede neemt hij het op tegen een bende genadeloze bandieten, wetend dat hij misschien alles zal verliezen in zijn zoektocht naar gerechtigheid.

programme.title: Go with God, Gringo
programme.desc: De gebroeders Cris beschuldigen Gringo vals van de moord op zijn broer. In de gevangenis wacht hem onrecht, tot de echte daders ontsnappen en Carmen ontvoeren. Gringo stort zich in gevaarlijke avonturen om zijn naam te zuiveren en haar te bevrijden.

programme.title: Stranger On Horseback
programme.desc: Circuitrechter Rick Thorne komt in Bannerman aan, waar alles in handen is van de rijke rancher Josiah Bannerman. Thorne ontdekt dat diens zoon, Tom, iemand heeft gedood zonder dat er iets tegen hem gedaan is. Thorne confronteert Tom en zet hem gevangen, wat leidt tot een gevaarlijke strijd om gerechtigheid.

programme.title: Django, Prepare a Coffin
programme.desc: Een revolverheld vormt een bende van "overleden" executieslachtoffers om wraak te nemen op de politicus en outlaw die zijn vrouw heeft vermoord.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands, voormalig Texas-marshal, wordt een huurmoordenaar nadat hij ontdekt dat casino-eigenaar Matt Garson verantwoordelijk is voor de moord op zijn broer, Billy Sands, een krantenschrijver. Hij reist naar Texas om gerechtigheid te zoeken, ondanks de prijs op zijn hoofd.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: De Mexicaanse boer Joaquin Murieta reist met zijn vrouw naar Californië op zoek naar goud, maar verliest alles aan wreedheid en racisme. Verteerd door verdriet vormt hij een bende om wraak te nemen, tot zijn eigen mannen hem verraden. Zijn lot bezegelt zich in een laatste, tragische confrontatie met de sheriff die hem ooit als vriend kende.

programme.title: Halleluja and Sartana Strike Again
programme.desc: Twee oplichters, waaronder een die zich voordoet als missionaris, proberen een kerkelijke groep te bedriegen. Maar in deze slapstick western raken ze verstrikt in de chaos van een gekke bende grondrovers. Humor, verwarring en avontuur volgen!

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 43, 44, 45
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: War Paint
programme.desc: Luitenant Billings moet binnen negen dagen een vredesverdrag bezorgen bij het opperhoofd Gray Cloud. Taslik, de zoon van het opperhoofd, leidt hen door het dorre land, maar water raakt op en spanning stijgt. Dan merken ze zijn oorlogskleuren op. Leidt hij hen echt naar vrede?

programme.title: Garden Of Evil
programme.desc: Drie Amerikanen op weg naar Californië stranden in een Mexicaans dorp en krijgen een aanbod: een vrouw helpen haar man te redden uit een ingestorte goudmijn. In de gevaarlijke bergen twijfelen ze tussen hebzucht, overleving en hun ware intenties.

programme.title: Die blutigen Geier von Alaska
programme.desc: Alaska tijdens de goudkoorts: Bontjager Don Rutland wordt onterecht beschuldigd van roof en moord. Terwijl hij vecht om te overleven, wordt hij bedreigd door rovers en de meedogenloze natuur. Met adembenemende decors, spannende actie en een meeslepende soundtrack biedt deze avonturenfilm pure sensatie.

programme.title: Savage Pampas
programme.desc: In de late jaren 1800 probeert een legerkapitein de open vlaktes van Argentinië, die worden beheerst door indianen en bandieten, te temmen. Om hem daarbij te helpen haalt de kapitein een groep vrouwen binnen om zijn soldaten tevreden te houden.

programme.desc: Bende sadistische cowboys laten niets in hun weg staan in hun zoektocht naar goud.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Een speciale agent uit Chicago wordt naar het westen gestuurd om de beruchte gebroeders Reno op te pakken.

programme.title: A Town Called Hell
programme.desc: Een groep Mexicaanse revolutionairen vermoordt een stadspriester en een aantal van zijn christelijke volgelingen. Tien jaar later arriveert een weduwe in de stad met de bedoeling wraak te nemen op de moordenaars van haar man.

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins

programme.title: Comin' at Ya!
programme.desc: De broers Pike en Polk vallen een bruiloft aan, schieten de bruidegom neer en ontvoeren vrouwen om ze te verkopen. H. H. Hart overleeft en jaagt de broers op. Hij bevrijdt de vrouwen, maar wordt gevangen genomen, enkel overlevend dankzij zijn gevangene Polk.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Appreciating island culture, host Michael Bonacini explores the enchanting region of Sardegna and its exceptional cuisine. Michael begins his island feast with a taste of the sea through his seasoned antipasto of Stuffed Snails. Next, Michael prepares a luxurious and delicate Lobster Spaghetti, highlighting the fresh seafood of the region. Moving inland for his secondo, Michael cooks up a traditional dish of Lamb with Artichokes and Saffron, a meal that combines three of Sardegna's most famous ingredients. To end his meal, Michael combines salty and sweet with a dolce of Honey and Cheese Fritters.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: One of Italy's quieter regions, Friuli Venezia Guilia offers iconic decadent dishes, waiting to be discovered. Renowned chef Michael Bonacini begins his exploration of the region with his take on a traditional meal: Cheese Crisp Baskets with Polenta and Mushrooms. This savoury antipasto is an elegant looking dish with humble flavours. For his primo, Michael prepares a unique Poppy Seed, Sage, and Prosciutto Pasta, a dish that is a twist on traditional pasta. Looking for a little heat in his secondo, Michael cooks up a meal of Spicy Tomato Scampi. The sweet meat of the scampi counters the heat of the sauce, creating a delicious flavour combination. To end his meal, Michael looks to the region's Austrian influence by preparing his dolce of Apricot Sweet Buns. Soft, sweet, and light these buns are the perfect way to wrap up a Friuli Venezia Guilia meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini uses the fresh ingredients from rich Tuscan soil to make regional dishes like Spinach Ricotta Gnudi.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini explores classic dishes from the central Italian region, Le Marche.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Start Here by Sohla El-Waylly! Follow along as Shahir makes a punch-you-in-the-face sauce, beautiful seared scallops, an indulgent chocolate pudding pie for grown-ups, and much more!

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from another award-winning cookbook: Mi Cocina by Rick Martinez! Follow along as Shahir prepares dishes from across Mexico, including juicy chicken al pastor, a beautiful whole grilled fish, quick and easy aguachile, and much more!

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini delves into the Italian region of Emilia- Romagna to discover its iconic cuisine. To start, Michael stays light with an airy Mortadella Mousse spread on fluffy Modena Mini Flatbreads. Next, Michael cooks up Tortellini in Broth, a dish originally from Bologna that can be easily altered to personal taste. Michael chooses to fill his tortellini with a rich and savoury mixture of prosciutto, mortadella, and ground pork. For his secondo, Michael uses traditional ingredients and pairs them in a tart, luxurious dish of Duck Breast with Balsamic Cherry Sauce. To wind down his meal, Michael whips up a creamy classic, Rice Custard Cake topped with a Cherry Glaze.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Chef Michael Bonacini explores sweet and spicy dishes hailing from the coastal region of Calabria. For his antipasto, Michael cooks up a light and refreshing Brioche with Gelato. Fluffy brioche buns surround the sweet flavours of gelato for a delicious start to your meal. Switching to spice for the primo, Michael introduces a Spicy Sausage and Ricotta Pasta. Full of sweet, savoury, and spicy flavours, this dish provides a strong, flavourful meal sure to please any crowd. For his secondo, Michael goes for a hearty Lamb au Gratin with Peas and Asparagus; a classic holiday dish that will warm any room. For his finale, Michael whips up a simple, yet impressive, Chocolate-covered Figs.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Full of luxurious treats, the northern Italian region of Lombardy offers rich and delicious cuisine. For his antipasto, celebrity chef Michael Bonacini prepares a delicate dish of Stuffed Squash Blossoms. Soft and light, these blossoms are enhanced with a creamy filling of parmesan, anchovies, and nutmeg. Following the fresh taste of flowers, Michael cooks up an impressive and rich Risotto Milanese. A feast for your eyes and taste buds, this risotto is coloured by saffron and its floral strands release flavour and colour as it's cooked. For his secondo Michael pairs a succulent Veal Roast with the sweet and sour Mustard Fruit to bring out a tangy delight. Michael's dolce looks solely at chocolate, creating a creamy and crunchy Chocolate Salami. Full of nuts, cookies, and creamy chocolate, this rich dessert is a wonderful way to finish off any meal.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Known for its lush landscape, Umbria is a region of that offers fresh, seasonal ingredients perfect for simple yet boldly flavoured cuisine. To begin his Umbrian feast, Chef Michael Bonacini serves up a sweet and spicy antipasto of Fried Spicy Tomato Flatbread. Seasoned with chili peppers for that bit of heat, Michael's antipasto is a humble yet satisfying snack. For his primo, Michael brings our attention to an Umbrian specialty: truffles! Prepared with light and fluffy pasta, Michael's Gnocchi with Black Truffle concentrates the decadent flavour of the truffle in the pillowy pasta to create a rich and delectable dish. Paying homage to the plights of farmers and fisherman, Michael's secondo combines the delicious flavours of land and sea. Michael's seasoned Seared Fish is paired with sweet and savoury lentils for a warm and homey dish. Finally, for Michael's dolce he bakes a warm and wintery Umbrian classic: Umbrian strudel.

programme.title: Capturing Winter S1 - "Aurélie Gonin"
programme.desc: Aurélie Gonin is one of the few women working in winter action sports filmmaking. Over the years she gathered expertise in every aspect of her field. We join as she directs an elite ski and snowboarding qualification event of the Freeride World Tour.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "LA"
programme.desc: In LA, we hike with wolfs, Ayurveda insights with Jay and a delicious meal from Karla. Marilia takes an adventurous leap from an airplane, showing the freedom in extreme sports.Tracy showcases the joy of pursuing passions with WCMX at the skate park.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Costa Rica"
programme.desc: Marilia explores Costa Rica, connecting with nature at Zunya, experiences a cacao ceremony with the Maleku Tribe, and finds wellness in Tamarindo's Cala Luna. At La Senda, she learns to appreciate nature's beauty and the importance of slowing down.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: Marilia's Irish journey, meeting land enthusiasts, explored scenic spots, encounters with Ellie and Hazel, vegan delights at Cornucopia, and concluded with a reflective sunset in the Wicklow Mountains, highlighting a strong community spirit.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Swakopmund"
programme.desc: Amidst the vast desert, we discover handmade leather shoes, the yellow bus on the beach, Kalahari truffles, the power of gemstones, keepers of the desert elephants and a skate ramp in the middle of the dunes.

programme.title: A Simple Path S1 - "Nairobi"
programme.desc: Uhuru Park is the nucleus for skateboarders in Gaborone. We meet street Keedz turning their lives around, a local animator, the producer of Sighkick Mag and learn how to make homemade trucks and sign language at Pallet Café.

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Jakarta"
programme.desc: Jakarta, urban meets jungle. The yellow brick road, shiny shoes at Survive Skate shop, 24/7 under the bridge. Road trip to Bandung, a mosque session, Nasi Padang Every Day, Bhang records, live with Sigit, motion graphics and self-expression.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "London"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx steps outside of her comfort zone to draw inspiration for her music track from urban youths in London’s Grime scene.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Amsterdam"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx travels to Amsterdam to influence her music track and discovers it’s a whole lot more experimental than she imagined.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Paris"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx travels to Paris, the city of love, for inspiration and discovers its diversity and a creative trend called retrofuture.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Nova Scotia"
programme.desc: Exploring Canada’s railway roots, Michael discovers Nova Scotia through Indigenous dance, log rolling with a champion, and surfing iconic waves.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "New Brunswick"
programme.desc: Michael explores New Brunswick by land, sea, and air. He traverses historic bridges and scenic coasts before taking to the skies.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Prince Edward Island"
programme.desc: Michael hunts for PEI’s lost railway but finds joy in a potato museum, deep-sea fishing, a rotating house, and Mi’kmaq cultural traditions.

programme.title: A Simple Path: The Worldwide Ride
programme.desc: Skateboarding and its do it yourself lifestyle has permeated into the worlds of art, music, and fashion. The constant progression and search for the new, attracts unique individuals from all walks of life.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Tokyo, Japan"
programme.desc: Vegas Bboy Ronnie is traveling to Japan to visit Bboy Shigekix in his hometown Tokyo. Shigekix will take Ronnie on an exciting Journey to show the Japanese culture and it's unique style of breaking and hip-hop.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Rotterdam, The Netherlands"
programme.desc: In the city of Rotterdam, three times world champion, Menno, hosts b-boy Junior from France. Both are considered legends. Menno takes Junior on a trip he will never forget and meet people who have all left their mark in the Dutch breaking community.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and with the advice of the Great Spirit vows to retake the land that belonged to his fathers.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In Safe Crackers, Pat and Stoney are ordered to break up a safe cracking gang preying on Colorado banks handling government silver bullion. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, the G-Men go to Denver to investigate a silver fraud. Starring Russel Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.desc: Recently released from prison, Vic Carver, and his brother Johnny, searches for Annies Uncle Luke to enact revenge. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie faces off against dangerous twin sisters, Dana and Jana Matthews. Annie is fast with a gun, but is she fast enough to take on a duo known as The Trigger Twins? Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Loser's End
programme.desc: This spine-tingling drama of the west stars Jack Perrin as a man out for revenge against an outlaw gang. Other stars include Tina Menard as the woman who helps him along the way, and Elias Lazoroff as the daring Don Carlos. Perrin (Jaws of Justice, The Apache Kid's Escape), was a familiar face in low budget westerns, his career spanning back to the silent era.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: Fighting Caravans
programme.desc: Clint Belmet (Gary Cooper) is a frontier scout with his hands full in this 1931 Paramount Pictures version of Zane Grey's novel. He's helping guide a wagon train across the country, fighting off various attacks on the way, and falling for his lovely Felice (Lily Damita). Belmet's grizzled companions think he should leave the woman alone, but it gets lonely out on the trail, and Felice's charms are hard to resist. Featuring such notable character actors of the period as Ernest Torrence, Tully Marshall, and Fred Kolher, this vintage Hollywood Western still packs a wallop!

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Painted Desert
programme.desc: A mightly melodrama of red-blooded action, William Boyd stars in the Pre-Code western talkie - The Painted Desert (1931). The first sound film for Hollywood heavyweight Clark Gable, The Painted Desert finds Boyd and Gable at odds over the affections of a cowboy's beautiful daughter (Helen Twelvetrees).

programme.title: Fugitive of the Plains
programme.desc: In this continuation of the much loved Billy the Kid serials featuring dreamboat Buster Crabbe (perhaps best known for his numerous appearances as Flash Gordon in the 30s and 40s), Billy finds himself joining an outlaw band led by women in order to, once again, clear his name after being wrongly accused of a crime he did not commit. Helmed by famed B-movie director Sam Newfield, this film also features Al St. John, whose lovable Fuzzy character was as essential to the PRC's Billy the Kid series as Billy himself.

programme.title: Revenge of the Virgins (Edited Version)
programme.desc: The angry and topless female members of a Native American prepare for battle when white treasure hunters move in on their sacred ground. Peter Perry Jr. (The Secret Sex Lives of Romeo and Juliet) directed this early nudie-cutie from a script by legendary cult filmmaker Ed Wood (Plan Nine from Outer Space). Writing under the pen name Peter LaRoche, Wood churned out this screenplay just before he reinvented himself as the author of seedy adult novels.

programme.title: Broadway to Cheyenne
programme.desc: A gang of big-city thugs trying to set up a protection racket out west meet their match in this B-Western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Rex Bell, billed on the old print ads as The heroic idol of young America! stars as Breezy Kildare, a New York detective who happens to be in Wyoming. When Breezy leads a group of cattleman against the well-armed city boys, the bad guys will wish theyd stayed in New York! The rest of the cast includes such favorites from the period as George Gabby Hayes, Roy DArcy, and Marceline Day. (Day worked opposite everyone from John Wayne to Buster Keaton, but retired from acting shortly after this movie at age 25.) Directed by Harry L. Fraser.

programme.title: Raiders of the Border
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Nevada Jack McKenzie (Johnny Mack Brown) and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) go undercover to catch jewelry smugglers in this vintage western from Monogram Pictures. This was one of the last films directed by John P. McCarthy (Song of the Gringo, The Oklahoma Cyclone), while Johnny Mack Brown would go on to find great success as Nevada Jack; this was the fourth of 19 films where he played the crime busting marshal.

programme.title: The Dude Ranger
programme.desc: Its nothing but action and thrills when an Easterner inherits a cattle ranch and discovers that thousands of cattle have been stolen. Secretly, he signs on as a hired hand at his own ranch to uncover the thief. Once he realizes whats going on, the city boy becomes a hard-riding, avenging son of a six- shooter! Directed by Edward F. Cline from a story by Zane Grey, the film stars George OBrien, Irene Hervey, and LeRoy Mason.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In Ghost Town Mystery, Pat and Stoney investigate the mysterious closing of a government silver mine and the ghost town left in its wake. They meet several suspicious characters in the empty town, one of whom holds the answers they seek. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men

Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.desc: Stoney and the son of the local Indian chief are attacked while escorting a gold shipment meant for the tribe. With his partner in jail, Pat endeavors to learn who is behind the robbery and the previous thefts of tools and supplies meant for the Indians before the tribe returns to the warpath to avenge the death of their kinsman.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, a Texas Ranger is shot down in cold blood. Determined to bring the killer to justice, the Judge and Jeff turn their focus on Curly, but with a lack of evidence the lawmen are patient until they break the case. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Luck O' The Irish
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery. In this episode, Judge Roy and Taggart are intrigued by the arrival of Pat O'Hara and his much younger wife Kate. Pat's fondess for drink and gambling has him involved with the town's rowdies who are eying his beautiful bride. The Judge helps sort things out.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, Deputy Jeff Taggart is cheated in a horse deal. When the trader is found murdered, Jeff is the chief suspect. Judge Bean has to discover the actual murderer to save his friend from the gallows. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, Judge Bean appoints himself as the legal guardian of a young man whose father was a member of an outlaw gang. Bean's reward -- the boy's uncle puts a $3000 bounty on his head ! Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, the Judge deals with a rigged election. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: A young boy runs away from home because he thinks his father is a coward for not standing up to his abusive boss. Jeff and Roy have to find the boy and convince him that his father is just doing what he has to do in order to provide for his family. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, a woman arrives in town looking for her son. Roy checks around, and finds out that her son is not only in the area, but has become a notorious outlaw. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.sub-title: S01 : E28 Spirit of the Law
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West.In this episode, Judge Bean intervenes when two brothers accuse each other of crimes including cattle rustling. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Winds of the Wasteland
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this Republic Pictures western about the final days of the Pony Express. Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: Doomed Caravan
programme.desc: Hoppy is enlisted to help protect Jane Travers' next caravan against robbers who have been terrorizing travelers. He comes across a wily pair of thieves who hve their men disguised as soldiers to escort the caravan. Hoppy isn't fooled for a second and busts up their plan with help from the Bar 20 boys. Not to be outdone, the thieves then capture everyone but Hoppy and puts them before a firing squad. Not it's up to Hoppy to rescue his friends singlehandedly. The cast includes William Boyd as Hopalong Cassidy, with Russell Hayden and Andy Clyde as Luky Jenkins and California Jack. For those counting, this was the 32nd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. They would be edited for syndication on television, bringing Hoppy and his friends to a whole new generation of fans.

programme.title: Ghost Town Gold [The Three Mesquiteers]
programme.desc: CAVALIERS OF THE CACTUS COUNTRY--ALWAYS READY FOR A FIGHT OR A FROLICK! The second entry in what would grow into a wildly popular series of Western Three Mesquiteers B-Movies produced by Republic Pictures, Ghost Town Gold tracks the titular trio as they attempt to recover the gold stolen by a gang in its effort to ruin the bank/mayor who ordered them to leave town. Frequent John Wayne collaborator Joseph Kane adds his signature directorial panache to this rousing shoot-em-up, setting the tone for a film series that was so rampantly successful, it spawned 50 sequels and a host of imitators from rival studios.

programme.title: Courageous Avenger
programme.desc: Gold, gangs, and the heroic fight for life! Johnny Mack Brown (Billy the Kid, Coquette) stars in this western thriller about murders going on in a mining community. Its a story full of twists, where the greed for gold is only surpassed by the struggle for life!

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. He's assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and learn about the emir's activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Pancho is taken hostage by a bank robber's sister.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. . The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho work to clear the name of a man who is accused of robbing freights in order to force a woman's freighting company out of business. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho get swindled by a fake cattle buyer. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: A rancher is found murdered after he threatens to disinherit his niece. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: A railroad detective pursues the infamous female outlaw, Belle Starr, after a herd of horses are stolen from the U.S. Calvalry. This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Belle Starr is played by Mary Windsor. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: The notorious John Wesley Hardin kills two people while on a cattle drive to Abilene. Matt and Frankie head out to bring him to justice. Richard Webb stars as John Wesley Hardin. Also starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Howard Negley, Robert Karnes amd John Eldredge. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired April 9, 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Frank and Jesse James
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark tracks down the James Brothers who seek revenge on the law following the death of their half-brother.This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle. Directed by William Witney. Episode first aired in 1954. Also, look for legendary tough guy actor lee Van Cleef as Jesse James.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Railroad detective Matt Clark is challenged by a band of freight-car robbers led by Apache chief Geronimo. This western adventure series earned a Primetime Emmy in 1955.. Starring Jim Davis and Mary Castle, plus Chief Yowlachie and Emile Meyer. Directed by William Witney.Produced by B movie veteran Edward J. White. Episode first aired in 1954.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben and Adam are in jail, about to be hung for a crime they didn't commit. Joe and Hoss must find out why the witnesses to the alleged crime have lied about what happened before the execution takes place. They receive help from a vagrant named Lassiter who is looking for the men who committed a lynching in Kansas years ago.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The son of a neighboring rancher intends to sell their land for a mining operation that will ruin the water rights agreement that Andy and Ben made years ago. Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: The Cartwrights take a young boy to the Ponderosa after the death of his mother. Hoss is the only one that is able to get through the boy's hostility and bitterness, but, as the two begin to get close, the boy's father breaks out of prison and comes to retrieve the boy.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Little Joe Cartwright tries to help a gypsy girl who was abandoned by her people - because they believed she was a werewolf.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies...

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.desc: Valentina Caruso and Francesco Gasparri explore the Strait of Messina, where unique underwater currents create an oceanic ecosystem within the Mediterranean. programme.title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.sub-title: Whats On Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Bernard

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.desc: Hoe kan je het beste een galopwissel rijden? Britt en George laten het vandaag zien. Tijdens een proef moet je dit ook kunnen. Daarna gaat Britt weer lekker op Eve rijden! Het is namelijk een tijdje geleden. Eve heeft het de afgelopen maanden iets rustiger gehad. Britt laat jullie zien hoe ze het rijden weer oppakt met Eve.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV

programme.desc: Britt vertelt een aantal dingen die je nooit moet doen in de buurt van de manege of de paarden! Ook krijgen paardenmensen vaak dingen te horen die echt super stom zijn. In deze video vertelt Esra 10 dingen die je nooit meer wilt horen.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Paardenpraat TV: Op George rijden zonder hoofdstel en zadel
programme.desc: Britt vond het heerlijk om lekker zonder zadel op Vito te rijden. Op George heeft ze nog niet zo vaak zonder zadel gereden! Britt en George blijven oefenen om steeds beter te worden. Eerst gaat Britt oefenen met George zonder zadel en op muziek, om George te laten wennen. Vervolgens gaat ze op George zonder hoofdstel rijden. Als dat maar goed gaat!

Als Faya de blinddoek wegdoet zingen de anderen happy birthday. Faya is jarig en haar vrienden hebben een extravagante hoed voor haar gekocht.

programme.title: Boes

programme.desc: Overal worden er vogeltjes geboren. Boes vindt de nestjes te klein en besluit kastjes te maken. Hoe hij ook zijn best doet, de vogels vinden zijn creaties maar niets en komen er niet bij in de buurt. Het blijkt dat Boes de enige is die ze mooi vindt!

programme.title: Boes
programme.desc: Het huis van Boes is ijskoud. Het schild van Dolly is helemaal bevroren en zij kan haar kop niet meer bewegen. Boes probeert haar te helpen maar haar schild valt uit elkaar. De kale naakte Dolly krijgt het natuurlijk ijskoud. Als dit maar goed afloopt...

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Boes: Paard roert met z'n staart
programme.desc: Het ongetemde paard is zo wild dat hij zich niet door Boes laat temmen. Boes probeert op zijn manier vrienden met hem te worden, maar het paard negeert hem. Uiteindelijk slaagt Boes erin een zadel op hem te zetten, maar of het paard dit ook leuk vindt is nog maar de vraag.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Boes: Hé, dat is mijn melk
programme.desc: Een pasgeboren kalf drinkt bij zijn moeder. Ondertussen komt er een mol alle melk stelen. Het kalfje wordt boos en begint aan alle uiers te zuigen. Als Boes de moeder komt melken, wordt het kalf helemaal boos en gaat achter Boes aan.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Viola maken kaartenhuisjes, maar bij Stradi wil het niet lukken. Hij wordt boos. Tot groot ongenoegen van Viola wil hij het probleem oplossen met lijm. Hun ruzie loopt zo hoog op, dat het met de allesklevende lijm gevaarlijk wordt.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het is kermis. Alle bewoners zijn aanwezig, en het is echt gezellig. Trump en Tromb proberen het feest te saboteren. Wat kunnen ze doen met de draaimolen, de fotostand en de toverhoed van Legato?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: In de ruïnes van het oude kasteel speelt Bass een heldenrol in een film. Hij is fier op het resultaat. Maar door een onvoorzichtigheid van Stradi en Viola wordt de filmband erg beschadigd. De kinderen lossen het wel op hun manier op!

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Trump en Tromb willen op een snelle manier geld verdienen. Ze blazen de brug van het dorp op, en plaatsen een vervangbrug. Daar innen ze tolgeld. De anderen beginnen een nieuwe brug te bouwen. Maar dat laten de twee boeven niet zomaar gebeuren.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Trump en Tromb hebben verschillende voorwerpen gestolen uit het kasteel. Ze verbergen die in een zelfgebouwde boomhut. Stradi en Viola ontdekken de hut op een van hun vele uitstapjes.

programme.title: Troetelbeertjes
programme.desc: Het is weer tijd om buikprents te verzamelen! Maar Kleine beer heeft nog geen buikprent weten te bemachtigen en is daarmee het enige jonge beertje zonder buikprent. Om indruk te maken liegt Kleine beer dat ze al een heleboel buikprents heeft. Zal haar leugen uitkomen?

programme.title: Troetelbeertjes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Troetelbeertjes: Als de bliksem
programme.desc: Kleine beer wil graag indruk maken op de andere beertjes met haar buikprent. Maar wanneer ze deze te vroeg gebruikt tijdens een storm, belandt ze midden in de bergen. Daar ontmoet ze Grams die haar een wijze les leert over het gebruik van haar buikprent.

programme.title: Pieter Konijn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E38 Pieter Konijn: Het verhaal van Jeremias Hengelaars concert
programme.desc: Wanneer het jaarlijkse vissersfeest van Jeremy in het water valt, is het aan Pieter om er alsnog een feest van te maken.

programme.title: Pieter Konijn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E39 Pieter Konijn: Het verhaal van de wegwippende Wipstaart
programme.desc: Pieter moet op zijn kleine zusje passen, maar wilt ook heel graag naar een feestje. Hij besluit haar slapend mee te nemen...

programme.title: Pieter Konijn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E40 Pieter Konijn: Het verhaal van Wipstaarts taart
programme.desc: Als de verjaardagstaart van Wipstaart is gestolen gaat Pieter er achteraan. Hij beland echter in het water met een grote hoeveelheid schurken.

programme.title: Pieter Konijn
programme.sub-title: S01 : E41 Pieter Konijn: Het verhaal van de verschrikkelijke valstrik
programme.desc: De roofdieren hebben er genoeg van om steeds maar weer vernederd te worden. Ze zetten een valstrik om eindelijk eens van die vervelende Pieter af te komen.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E91 De Smurfen: De Laatste Smurfbei
programme.desc: Grote Smurf organiseert een bemanning om naar Smurfbessen Eiland te varen, omdat Gargamel alle bomen heeft gedood, behalve één, om de Smurfen te vangen. Gargamel volgt hen, maar de Heks van Smurfbessen Eiland stuurt haar neusetende zeemeeuwen op hem af.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E92 De Smurfen: Hogatha's Hartje
programme.desc: Agatha de heks belooft Gargamel een magische fluit als hij haar in contact brengt met de tovenaar van haar dromen. Maar ze worden allebei bedrogen door elkaars bedrog.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E93 De Smurfen: Wie Bindt De Kat De Bel Aan?
programme.desc: Gargamel spreekt een betovering uit over een bel die aan Azraëls staart hangt, zodat de kat de weg naar de Smurfen zal vinden. Grote Smurf troeft hem echter af met een tegenspreuk.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen Mita en Popo over hun ijsvisreisje in Nunavik met hun vriend Amaruk.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen hun avontuur in Tokyo (Japan) waar ze op zoek gingen naar de zak met verjaardagscadeautjes die ze voor Mita en Popo gekocht hadden en die per ongeluk door een moeder en haar baby meegenomen werd.

programme.title: Mouk
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Mouk: Een Helpende Hand
programme.desc: Mouk en Chavapa vertellen hun avontuur in een klein Senegalees dorp. Ze helpen een nieuwe vriend om op tijd aan te komen op een trouwfeest waar hij muziek moet spelen. Onderweg helpen ze vele mensen voort.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Flamingo
programme.desc: Dierverzorger Paul beantwoordt al jullie dierenvragen, dus kom erachter waarom flamingo’s roze zijn of wat flamingo’s eten. Paul laat zien hoe flamingo’s met hun snavel voedsel eten en ik zet het eten voor de flamingo’s klaar.

programme.title: StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 StoryZoo en Carlijn's Dierenvraag - Dieren op transport
programme.desc: Weet jij hoe een dierentuin aan zijn dierbewoners komt? DierenPark Amersfoort werkt samen met bijna 350 Europese dierentuinen. We begeleiden de verhuizing van de leeuwenwelpen en vertellen hoe de verhuizing van zulke roofdieren gaat.

programme.title: StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele: Rijdend In Een Treintje
programme.desc: Tsjoeke tsjoeke tsjoek. Treintje gaat vertrekken, instappen! Snel snel snel!

programme.title: StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 StoryZoo & Dirk Scheele: Kleuren
programme.desc: Zie jij alle kleuren van de regenboog?

programme.desc: Op de Bibaboerderij beleven boer Bart en boerin Bibi samen met de didadiertjes, fifafruitjes en gigagroentes, de leukste avonturen! Terwijl Bibi goed voor iedereen zorgt, hangt Bart de onhandige boer uit.

programme.title: Bibaboerderij
programme.desc: Op de Bibaboerderij beleven boer Bart en boerin Bibi samen met de didadiertjes, fifafruitjes en gigagroentes, de leukste avonturen! Terwijl Bibi goed voor iedereen zorgt, hangt Bart de onhandige boer uit.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E30 De Smurfen: De Slechtweer Smurf
programme.desc: Het is tijd voor de jaarlijkse picknick in het bos, maar het regent! Knutsel heeft een idee en maakt een “weermachine”. Met deze machine kunnen de Smurfen kiezen welk weer het wordt. Maar wat als ze allemaal een ander weertype willen ?

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E31 De Smurfen: Dichtersmurf En Schildersmurf
programme.desc: Omdat ze zich niet gewaardeerd voelen, besluiten Dichtersmurf en Schildersmurf om het dorp te verlaten. Ze gaan op weg naar Stormeiland, zich er niet van bewust zijnde dat Gargamel hen in de val wil lokken. Gelukkig snellen Grote Smurf en zijn trouwe volgelingen hun ter hulp.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E32 De Smurfen: De Onderaardse Smurfen
programme.desc: Er dreigt hongersnood bij de Smurfen. Op hun zoektocht naar eten vinden de uitgehongerde Smurfen een voorraad bevroren voedsel, bewaakt door een bevroren trol, in een mysterieuze grot. De grot herbergt ook een magische diamant. Wanneer de Smurfen de grot ontdooien, probeert Gargamel het voedsel te stelen.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E33 De Smurfen: Smurfen Hebben Het Duivels Moeilijk
programme.desc: Gedurende één van zijn wandelingen vindt Knustelsmurf een kristallen bol. Deze kristallen bol toont de innerlijke wensen van degene die ernaar kijkt. Deze werd gemaakt door onderaardse trollen die op zoek zijn naar slaven om in hun mijnen te werken.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E34 De Smurfen: Gargamel De Barmhartige
programme.desc: In een poging om te weten te komen waar de geheime voorraad diamanten van de Smurfen zich bevindt, doet Gargamel zich voor als hun vriend. Wanneer zijn ware aard weer boven komt, spreekt Grote Smurf een magische formule uit om zijn Smurfjes te redden uit de handen van de gemene tovenaar.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E35 De Smurfen: De Smurfen En De Geldboom
programme.desc: Gargamel krijgt hulp van zijn moeder om de Smurfen te vangen. Ze hebben het geweldige idee om de Smurfen proberen te verleiden met geld. Deze kennen het gebruik van geld niet. Zal Smulsmurf zich echter laten vangen?

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E36 De Smurfen: Een Robotsmurf
programme.desc: Knutsel heeft een robot ontworpen die alle klusjes moet opknappen. Maar Brilsmurf heeft ermee geknoeid en Robotsmurf verlaat het dorp. Hij komt terecht in een kasteel. Daar overtuigt hij een jonge prins om naar het smurfendorp te gaan en de Smurfen om hulp te vragen om zo zijn koninkrijk terug te winnen van zijn boosaardige tante.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E37 De Smurfen: Het Versmurfte Paradijs
programme.desc: Luilaksmurf droomt dat hij op een paradijselijk eiland is en geen klusjes meer moet uitvoeren van Grote Smurf. Zijn droom wordt echter snel een nachtmerrie…

programme.desc: Kijk nu de Aftermovies van De PaardenpraatTV fandagen van 2019 en 2020. Het waren weer twee fantastische edities. Het was een geweldig weekend met geweldige shows, trouwe fans en gezellige meet and greets. Britt en Esra hebben stiekem nu al weer zin in de volgende editie.

programme.title: Bibaboerderij

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.desc: George heeft een veulentje gekregen en Britt gaat op bezoek! Wat is Silver lief! Ook gaat ze langs bij veulentje Popcorn. En er staat nog iets heel leuks op de planning: Britt gaat Riva, de dochter van George, voor het eerst ontmoeten! Ze mag zelfs een stukje op Riva rijden.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.desc: Hoe kan je het beste een galopwissel rijden? Britt en George laten het vandaag zien. Tijdens een proef moet je dit ook kunnen. Daarna gaat Britt weer lekker op Eve rijden! Het is namelijk een tijdje geleden. Eve heeft het de afgelopen maanden iets rustiger gehad. Britt laat jullie zien hoe ze het rijden weer oppakt met Eve.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.desc: Het is weer tijd voor een paardenrassen video. Britt en Esra laten je onder andere het fjordenpaard, de Haflinger en de Spaanse Andalusiër zien. Wat maakt deze rassen zo bijzonder? Britt en Esra zoeken het voor jullie uit.
